scripts.title: autofarm levels
scripts.features:
spawns a lot of mini aliens that gives you a lot of levels

while also using an admin knife that does inf damage to kill them.

please note that doing this in public servers may risk your levels being reset by an admin and a ban from the game which I why I recommend farming in private servers if you wanna get on leaderboards.
